capabilities: : Display contact details in detail cards
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that lets you reference contacts from a CardDAV address book directly from your notes.
problem: Users need a way to easily reference and access contact details stored in external CardDAV address books directly within their Obsidian notes without leaving the app.
summary: A plugin that allows users to reference contacts from a CardDAV address book directly within Obsidian notes using an inline syntax.
